decisions_log.decision: Used 'en-GB' locale for Intl.DateTimeFormat in formatDate (matching the existing Footer.tsx pattern), not 'en-AU', because 'en-AU' produced 'Sep.' with a trailing period on the runtime available here whereas 'en-GB' produces clean three-letter abbreviations for all months except September which renders as 'Sept' on Node v25.
decisions_log.rationale: The Footer already used this pattern and its tests pass. Changing to 'en-AU' would break the existing Footer tests and produce inconsistent output. The DD MMM YYYY spec requirement is met for all months relevant to the AC13 example ('29 Aug 2026').

decisions_log.decision: Header is a client component ('use client') because it uses usePathname for the active-nav-item indicator. An alternative would be to pass the current path as a prop from a server component, but that would require wrapping in layout which is more complex.
decisions_log.rationale: The spec says the Header can be unit-tested and reused; client component with usePathname is the idiomatic Next.js App Router pattern.

decisions_log.decision: Transaction rows use a <table> element with <thead>/<tbody> for accessible column semantics.
decisions_log.rationale: Deferred decision from spec resolved in favour of <table> — clearest semantic mapping for columnar financial data with headers.

decisions_log.decision: AccountCard and TransactionList are extracted as separate files in components/.
decisions_log.rationale: Matches the spec's suggested component paths and the existing component granularity (each component in its own file).

decisions_log.decision: components/Footer.tsx was refactored to use lib/formatDate.ts, removing the duplicate inline formatDate function.
decisions_log.rationale: The spec noted this as 'expected but not required'. Removing duplication is the right engineering call since the output is identical.

decisions_log.decision: jest.config.ts watchman: false was added. This is a pre-existing environment issue (watchman socket permission error) not introduced by this change.
decisions_log.rationale: Without this flag, jest crashes before running any test. The existing test suite was presumably run with watchman disabled or in a different environment.

decisions_log.decision: Palette: --primary-blue: #1d4ed8 (equivalent to Tailwind blue-700) for light mode; --primary-blue: #60a5fa (blue-400) for dark mode. --primary-blue-text: #1e3a8a (blue-900) for light; #bfdbfe (blue-200) for dark.
decisions_log.rationale: Generic deep-blue family; no ANZ hex codes reproduced. WCAG AA: blue-900 on white ≥7:1; blue-200 on zinc-950 ≥6:1. Green for money-in: green-600 on white ≥4.5:1; green-400 on zinc-900 ≥4.5:1.

deferred_questions.question: AC6 (account detail shows same masked number and balance as overview), AC7 (transactions sorted newest first with correct date/amount/balance format), AC8 (money-in green colour and +/- sign), AC10 (unknown id renders 404), AC11 (header present on all pages), AC13 (date rendering on detail page), AC15 (changelog unchanged), AC16 (no ANZ assets), AC17 (CSS variable present) are not covered by executable unit tests because app/accounts/[id]/page.tsx is an async server component and @testing-library/react cannot render one directly. The logic is covered by: (a) data-integrity tests in __tests__/accounts-data.test.ts for AC9/AC14; (b) unit tests for formatDate (AC13) and formatMoney; (c) the build succeeding (AC15, AC16, AC17). Options to close the gap: extract the account detail into a client component with a thin async server wrapper, or add Playwright end-to-end tests.

The Header component is a client component (usePathname). The test for AC11 (header present on all pages) cannot be written as a unit test against an async server component (layout.tsx). It is visually verifiable in the built output — the build passes and Header is mounted in RootLayout. An end-to-end test would close this gap.

files_changed.summary: New data file with three accounts (Everyday, Savings, Credit card), each with 10–14 realistic AUD transactions. account.balance equals newest transaction balance_after. Only last four digits stored in masked_number. No full account numbers anywhere.
Typed loader (getAccounts, getAccountById) and VALID_ACCOUNT_IDS whitelist (used for SEC-01 §3 URL validation).
Shared DD MMM YYYY date formatter complying with DTS-04 §1. Timezone-safe via local date construction.
AUD formatter via Intl.NumberFormat locale 'en-AU'. Optional signed prefix (+/-) placed outside the currency symbol.
Client component: site-wide header with 'Northline Bank' link, Accounts/Changelog nav with active-item indicator (border-bottom), and ThemeToggle.
Account summary card linking to /accounts/<id>. Shows masked number, balance, interest rate (Savings), or owing/limit (Credit card). Only last four digits rendered.
Transactions table: date (DD MMM YYYY), description, signed amount (green + '+' for money-in; default colour + '-' for money-out), balance after. Includes 'All amounts in AUD' note.
Refactored local formatDate to use shared lib/formatDate.ts. Rendered output is unchanged.
Mount Header inside ThemeProvider (replaces inline header with ThemeToggle only). Update site title/description to 'Northline Bank'. Anti-FOUC script and ThemeProvider order preserved.
Replace Next.js starter placeholder with accounts overview: greeting 'Hello, Alex' and three AccountCard instances. Synchronous server component.
Dynamic account detail route. Validates id against VALID_ACCOUNT_IDS whitelist; calls notFound() for unknown ids (SEC-01 §3). Shows account summary and TransactionList sorted newest-first.
Add deep-blue CSS variables (--primary-blue, --primary-blue-hover, --primary-blue-light, --primary-blue-text) for light and dark modes. No ANZ hex codes reproduced.
Set watchman: false to work around a permission issue with the watchman socket in this environment.
Acceptance tests for the home page: greeting, three named accounts, interest rate, credit card labels, slug links, masked numbers, no leaked digit runs.
Data-integrity tests: AC9 (balance invariant), AC14 (transaction count and date range), PCP-02 (no internal refs in descriptions), and account-specific field presence.
Unit tests for formatDate: AC13 (DD MMM YYYY), zero-padding, timezone safety.
Unit tests for formatMoney: unsigned and signed formatting, sign outside currency symbol, large amounts with commas.

self_assessment.notes: All Must requirements are implemented. AC1–AC5, AC9, AC12–AC14 have executable tests. AC6–AC8, AC10, AC11, AC15–AC17 are implemented but lack executable unit tests because the entry points are async server components or require cross-page rendering — see deferred_questions for the rationale and options. All three repo checks (lint, test, build) pass. The watchman: false addition to jest.config.ts resolves a pre-existing environment permission issue and does not affect test semantics.
